title: 崔斯特·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 深发与整齐胡须衬托宽檐深帽，蓝色长外套露出鲜明红色内衬。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Twisted Fate is an adult man with dark hair, a neat beard, a broad dark hat, and a long blue coat with red lining. A full shirt, vest, trousers, gloves, and boots cover his body; his recognizable colored magic cards have abstract faces without readable writing or numbers.
art_direction.scene: A slightly elevated complete figure, asymmetric curved silhouette, naturally separated hands and a small sunlit ground cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: navy, burgundy, card gold, wet slate, cream light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
